The navigation grid of a numeric lattice axis

Source: R/lattice_layer_processor.R
lattice_axis_grid.Rd

What the frontend's grid mode needs to lay a scatter out in cells: the drawn range and the step between the ticks lattice draws. Those are pretty(limits, n = tick.number) – the call lattice's own formattedTicksAndLabels() makes – unless the chart placed them with at =. Ticks placed unevenly have no one step, and the grid is left without one rather than given a step the axis does not show.

Usage

lattice_axis_grid(
  limits,
  log = FALSE,
  at = NULL,
  tick_number = NULL,
  packet = 1L
)

Arguments

limits

The packet's limits on this axis

log

The axis' log scale component

at

The axis' at scale component: FALSE, the tick positions, or a list of them with one element per packet

tick_number

The axis' tick.number scale component

packet

The packet, to pick its ticks from a per-packet at

Value

A list with min, max and, when the ticks are evenly spaced, tickStep; NULL for an axis that is not a finite numeric range on a linear scale.
